jan_recommendation: Mild winter weather with little rain, great for beach walks and outdoor sightseeing!
feb_recommendation: Dry and pleasant winter days, perfect for exploring temples and the beach.
mar_recommendation: Summer warmth is building, plan outdoor visits for mornings and evenings and stay hydrated.
apr_recommendation: Hot and humid summer days, wear light cotton clothes and drink plenty of water.
may_recommendation: Peak summer heat, avoid the midday sun and choose indoor or evening activities.
jun_recommendation: Still very hot with only light monsoon showers, stay hydrated and plan indoor breaks.
jul_recommendation: Hot days with occasional evening showers, carry a small umbrella just in case.
aug_recommendation: Warm and humid with more frequent showers, keep an umbrella handy for afternoon rain.
sep_recommendation: Warm monsoon weather with regular showers, keep your outdoor plans flexible.
oct_recommendation: Northeast monsoon rains begin, expect heavy showers, carry an umbrella and plan indoor activities.
nov_recommendation: The wettest month with heavy rain and possible flooding, check local advisories and keep plans flexible.
dec_recommendation: Mild winter weather with some lingering rain early in the month, pack a light rain jacket.
